final: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT ID, Date, HGB, `T-BIL`, CRE, CENTROMEA, CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE != 0 THEN CAST(`T-BIL` AS REAL) / CAST(CRE AS REAL) ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered_data GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM group_stats) SELECT gs.CENTROMEA, gs.avg_hgb, gs.avg_ratio, gs.avg_ratio / om.overall_avg_ratio AS ratio_divided_by_overall_mean FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
